Ensure BPCells Storage Order

bp_ensure_storage_order.Rd

Returns a BPCells matrix with the requested physical storage order. If the input already has that order, it is returned unchanged. Otherwise, a companion BPCells directory is written with BPCells::transpose_storage_order().

Usage

bp_ensure_storage_order(
  y,
  order = c("row", "col"),
  outdir = NULL,
  tmpdir = tempdir(),
  load_bytes = 4194304L,
  sort_bytes = 1073741824L
)

Arguments

y

A BPCells-backed matrix.

order

Desired physical storage order, either "row" or "col".

outdir

Directory where the companion BPCells matrix should be written when conversion is required. Required if y is not already in the desired order.

tmpdir

Temporary directory passed to BPCells::transpose_storage_order().

load_bytes, sort_bytes

Tuning arguments passed to BPCells::transpose_storage_order().

Value

A BPCells matrix with the requested physical storage order.
